topic: 海马尖波涟漪（SWR）发生器机制：CA3 递归爆发与 CA1 涟漪振荡回路

sources.title: Hippocampal sharp waves: their origin and significance
sources.use_in_article: 奠定 SWR 来源于 CA3 群体爆发的基本框架；描述 SWR 的形态和行为状态相关性
sources.notes: 经典奠基性论文；40 年后仍被广泛引用

sources.title: Two-stage model of memory trace formation: a role for 'noisy' brain states
sources.use_in_article: 两级记忆形成模型：探索（θ，弱编码）→ 静息（SWR，强固化）
sources.notes: 理论模型，后续大量实验验证；仍是记忆固化领域核心框架

sources.title: Hippocampal sharp wave-ripple: A cognitive biomarker for episodic memory and planning
sources.use_in_article: 综合综述：SWR 特征、时序压缩约 20 倍、功能（记忆固化+规划+决策）
sources.notes: 最全面的 SWR 综述之一；开放全文可用但时间有限仅读取摘要和关键数字

sources.authors: Oliva A, Fernández-Ruiz A, Buzsáki G, Berényi A
sources.title: Role of Hippocampal CA2 Region in Triggering Sharp-Wave Ripples
sources.use_in_article: CA2 作为清醒期 SWR 触发源（提前 15-20 ms 放电）
sources.notes: 发现 CA2 的触发角色；光遗传抑制 CA2 降低清醒 SWR 发生率

sources.authors: Maingret N, Girardeau G, Todorova R, Goutierre M, Zugaro M
sources.title: Hippocampo-cortical coupling mediates memory consolidation during sleep
sources.use_in_article: 三振荡协调（SWR + 慢振荡 + 纺锤波）的因果重要性；闭环刺激增强记忆
sources.notes: 首次直接因果证据：强化三振荡协调显著改善记忆

sources.title: Disruption of ripple-associated hippocampal activity during rest impairs spatial learning in the rat
sources.use_in_article: 破坏 SWR 相关活动 → 空间学习受损（因果证据）
sources.notes: 经典因果实验；与 Girardeau 2009 (PMID:19749750) 共同奠定 SWR 因果必要性

sources.authors: Donoso JR, Schmitz D, Maier N, Kempter R
sources.title: Hippocampal Ripple Oscillations and Inhibition-First Network Models: Frequency Dynamics and Response to GABA Modulators
sources.use_in_article: 涟漪产生的 PING/ING 回路机制；频率由 GABA_A 时间常数决定；两条 Schaffer 侧支路径
sources.notes: 结合计算模型和切片实验；频率由 GABA 时间常数决定是主要贡献

sources.authors: Schieferstein N, Del Toro A, Evangelista R, Imbrosci B, Swaminathan A, Schmitz D, Maier N, Kempter R
sources.title: Propagation of sharp wave-ripple activity in the mouse hippocampal CA3 subfield in vitro
sources.use_in_article: CA3c → CA3a 方向传播波；传播速度与轴突 AP 速度一致
sources.notes: 2024 年最新；体外切片；需体内验证

sources.authors: Morici JF, Silva A, Lima-Paiva I, Pronier É, Girardeau G
sources.title: Dorsoventral hippocampus neural assemblies reactivate during sleep following an aversive experience
sources.use_in_article: 协调 SWR 整合背腹海马空间和情绪记忆重激活
sources.notes: 2026 年最新；强调 SWR 协调跨区域整合的功能；需独立重复

sources.authors: Pronier É, Morici JF, Girardeau G
sources.title: The role of the hippocampus in the consolidation of emotional memories during sleep
sources.use_in_article: SWR 整合情绪记忆（背腹轴协调）的背景综述
sources.notes: 综述；为 2026 年 Girardeau 研究提供背景

limitation_notes: PMID:3026567 (1986) 和 PMID:2687720 (1989) 均超出 PMC 开放获取时限，仅摘要可用
PMID:29453207 (Donoso 2018) 无 PMC 全文；内容基于摘要
PMID:39216085 (Schieferstein 2024) 为最新研究，体外切片数据，体内验证尚需
PMID:41922515 (Morici 2026) 为单实验室最新结果，需独立重复
